What We're Looking For

Beyond Good. Truly Exemplary.

Excellence Beyond Competence

Not just "did the job well," but did something uniquely valuable

Impact Beyond Compliance

Not just "had good processes," but created measurable, lasting change

Industry Contribution Beyond Project Success

Not just "client was happy," but advanced the profession and shared knowledge

Innovation Beyond Standard Practice

Not just "followed best practices," but created new best practices

Legacy Beyond Completion

Not just "finished the project," but left lasting impact and transformed relationships

The Deciding Factor:

Would we want to publish this as a case study?

Would others learn from this?

Is this truly exemplary, not just competent?

Why Participate?

Recognition & Credibility

Industry-recognized validation of your excellence from the Project Business Foundation

Knowledge Sharing

Contribute to advancing the profession and share your innovations with peers

Case Study Publication

Winners featured in published case studies on PBF platforms

Professional Network

Connect with other exemplary contractors and industry leaders

Feedback & Improvement

Constructive feedback to strengthen future submissions

(Stage 1 participants)

CATEGORIES

Based on customer-facing project headcount

Small 

1-25 people in customer projects

Includes freelancers and solo practitioners. Recognizing agility, individual accountability, and innovative approaches in boutique delivery.

Medium

25-100 people in customer projects

Growing organizations establishing processes and scaling operations. Recognizing the balance of agility and structure.

Large

101+ people in customer projects

Established organizations with formal processes. Recognizing large-scale delivery excellence and enterprise solutions.

Who can apply?

1 / Project Type

Cross-corporate customer-contractor projects (all industries) 

2 / Role

You acted as an independent contractor for a paying client under contract

3 / Timeline

Project completed within the last 2 years (2024-2025) or currently running

4 / Client Involvement:

Client must complete assessment form  

5 / Publication

Accept publication of a short case profile if selected

What You'll Submit

Written Submission

  • ~ 2,000-word narrative covering objectives, outcomes, governance, and more

  • ~ 500-word section: "What Makes This Exemplary?"

  • ~ 300-word section: "Impact Measurement & Transformation"

  • ~ 300-word section: "Lessons Learned & Industry Contribution"

Evidence Artifacts

  • Draft contract matrix

  • Customer-contractor interface RACI

Client Assessment Form

  • Your client representative completes and submits an independent assessment

Publication Consent

  • Agreement to publish a short case story if you're selected as a winner or finalist

The Assessment Process

STAGE 1

Volunteer Review

  • Trained assessors evaluate all submissions

  • Assessment based on evidence-driven framework

  • Top submissions shortlisted for Stage 2

  • Feedback provided to all participants

STAGE 2

Judging Panel

  • Shortlisted nominees present to expert jury

  • 20-minute presentation + 15-minute Q&A

  • High-profile industry experts evaluate

  • Winners selected through consensus scoring

PBF Contractor of the year Volunteer Team

We are a global team of project management professionals dedicated to the art and science of Project Business. After earning our Project Business Professional (PBP) certification from the Project Business Foundation, we united with a shared mission: to elevate the standards of customer-facing projects worldwide.

Supported and sponsored by the Project Business Foundation, our team has meticulously crafted every aspect of this award—from the initial conceptualization and rigorous criteria to the digital home you are visiting today. Beyond building this platform, we are here to serve as your Coaches. Our goal is to guide nominees through the application process, ensuring your project’s story is told with the excellence it deserves.

FAQ

How much does it cost to apply?

Free. There is no application fee.

 

Can I submit multiple projects?

No, one user can submit one application for a year. In case you or your company would like to submit multiple projects, please use a different email account for each nomination.

​

What if my project is still ongoing?

Ongoing projects are eligible as long as you can demonstrate substantial progress and outcomes to date.

​

Do I need my client's permission?

Yes. Your client must complete an assessment form as part of your submission.

​

What happens to my submission data?

All materials are retained for 1 year after the award cycle, then archived or deleted in accordance with GDPR.

​

Can I save my submission as a draft?

Yes. You can save and edit your submission before final submission.

​

What if I have questions during submission?

Your assigned Nominee Coach is your single point of contact for all questions and support.

Any Questions? Contact us.
